prompt: Add an eval case `berlin-temperature` to climate-desk/: the user asks "What is the weather in Berlin?" and the case must check that the reply states a temperature in degrees (any number of degrees, not one particular value). Keep the other cases, run the evaluation and report the result.

checks.why: a number followed by degrees is `expect.regex`; `contains` on the fake model's value fits one reply only

reference: Add {"id": "berlin-temperature", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is the weather in Berlin?"}], "expect": {"regex": "(?i)\\b\\d+(\\.\\d+)? ?(°|degrees)"}} (a regex, since `contains` matches fixed text: "90 degrees" is the fake model's value only), run `graph-agents-cli eval run` (exit 0) and report it as a plumbing check on the fake model.
